notes.title: The Stonks Market is Now Open
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/25fe395ca8e9c8e3e697ed2ac9d78971433d623f.png[/img]

[i]How's your portfolio doing?[/i]

Today we're pleased to release [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1554080]The Stonks Market[/url][/b], right here on Steam. It's a simple trading simulator with a funny story about a rather clueless guy who gets into all kinds of trouble through the stock market.

You'll get access to a basic trading terminal, a stimulus check, and enough time to risk it all gambling on bad plays you've barely researched. All of this while you contend with a frustrated wife, too many know-it-all advisors, and the crippling fear of losing it all in an instant. Kinda like real-life, huh?

 [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/e5897f78b0550828efc32164b8e789b89a33d162.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/7dd5875707b4d4bf76c798b20bfecfcd38f8fc12.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/4f361d8313e12f7becca7bfedcb7903ee21b75e1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/886ee68add5c804f1bd88f273316353a8fd26473.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/4939a247b3b956d695b042d49d869b7ee4143e98.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/06a8eb6883f9f8f57763dd68d1404ea119e79da5.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/9683675a3db573cc8d09c196b6eb46b113537c2e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/c8711d7cb90376669f022f459fd119df39f7f9f4.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/98343e79c7032f572fc88d8a8d9d1e9bfd5801ae.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/f691051397262966098218cde1f56dd70e15fcfe.png[/img][/url]

Whether you're an avid stock bro, a crayon-eating monkey, or never touched a trading app in your life, [b]The Stonks Market[/b] is worth a few laughs. We hope you enjoy all its wild characters and bizarre scenarios.

------

The game is available right now with a [b]25% Launch Discount[/b]:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1554080

You can also pick it up as part [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/20966/The_Stale_Meme_Collection/]The Stale Meme Collection[/url][/b] for even more savings:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/20966

Oh, and one more thing...

[h2]ALL APES TO THE MOON! 🚀 💎🙌[/h2]

notes.title: New Level Added: Karen Visits The Salon
notes.content:
Hello Karens! 👱‍♀️

First and foremost we'd like to take the chance to thank all of you who've played, gifted, or streamed the game. Especially, we appreciate all the lovely reviews that you've been leaving on the game. When we started this project we did not expect it to make so many of you laugh, and it's been a delight receiving all the positive feedback and seeing so many of you enjoy the work.

So, in thanks for the support (and because our [url=http://twitch.tv/vagabonddog]Twitch community[/url] bullied us into it), we've added a new level to the game. It's accessible on the hub map, and available for [b]FREE[/b] to everyone!

Lastly, the game is on sale until [b]Oct 26[/b] with a [b]20% discount[/b], making it less than [b]$2.50[/b] USD.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1361110
We hope you enjoy the new level, and consider following us on [url=http://twitter.com/vagabonddog]Twitter[/url], [url=http://twitch.tv/vagabonddog]Twitch[/url], or [url=http://discord.gg/vd]Discord[/url] to keep up with new game developments, updates, and more. We can't wait to hear from you! 💅
[h3]- Vagabond Dog[/h3]
___________________________________________________________________

[h2][b]New Level:[/b] The Salon[/h2]
Take Karen to the local salon so she can get her routine haircut from her favourite stylist. It's so important to take care of your image, because at the end of the day, your look is what defines you. Just be careful if your temper flares around Rudolpho; he is well-versed in Karen's ways and will not be taking your shit.

[h3]Additional Changes:[/h3]
[list][*]We changed how Karen yells to give her a wider variety of shrieks
[*]Cloud saves have been enabled
[*]Made the difficulty options more clear
[*]Failure now sends player to the hub menu
[*]Option presented to switch difficulty on successive failures
[*]Improved hub navigation against double-pressed keys
[*]Adjusted some volume levels in various places
[*]Changed requirements to access final level
[*]Reordered hub map to accomodate new level
[/list]
